name: abs
doc: Returns the absolute value of number.

name: all
doc: Returns true only if every value/item is truthy. Same two calling forms as min(): all(a, b, ...) or all(list).

name: any
doc: Returns true if at least one value/item is truthy. Same two calling forms as min(): any(a, b, ...) or any(list).

name: ceil
doc: Rounds number up toward positive infinity.

name: float
doc: Coerces value to a floating-point number (strings/bools are converted; invalid strings become 0).

name: floor
doc: Rounds number down toward negative infinity.

name: int
doc: Truncates value toward zero and returns it as a number. Strings/bools are coerced first (invalid strings become 0).

name: len
doc: Returns the length of a string, list, or dict (character count / item count / entry count). Returns 0 for any other type.

name: max
doc: Returns the largest value. Same two calling forms as min(): max(a, b, ...) or max(list).

name: min
doc: Returns the smallest value. Call it either as min(a, b, ...) with two or more arguments, or as min(list) with a single list -- returns nil if given nothing and no list.

name: pow
doc: Returns base raised to exponent (base ** exponent).

name: print
doc: Prints every argument, converted with the same rules as str(), separated by single spaces, followed by one newline. Accepts zero or more arguments of any type -- print() alone just prints a blank line.

name: range
doc: Builds a list of numbers. Three calling forms: range(end) counts 0..end-1; range(start, end) counts start..end-1; range(start, end, step) steps by step (negative step counts down). Overload note: this entry shows the 1-argument form -- range(start, end) and range(start, end, step) are also valid.

name: reversed
doc: Returns a new list with list's items in reverse order. Non-list input returns an empty list.

name: round
doc: Rounds number to the nearest integer (half away from zero).

name: sorted
doc: Returns a new list with list's items sorted ascending (numbers compare numerically, strings lexicographically). Non-list input returns an empty list.

name: sqrt
doc: Returns the square root of number.

name: str
doc: Converts value to its display string (the same formatting print() uses).

name: sum
doc: Returns the numeric total. Same two calling forms as min(): sum(a, b, ...) or sum(list); non-numeric items coerce to 0.

name: type
doc: Returns the type name of value as a string: "nil", "bool", "number", "string", "list", "dict", "function", "instance", "class", "coroutine", "native", "bound", or "exception".
